title: Agentic Engineering · free course
summary: Trailer for the free Agentic Engineering course.

scenes.narration: Coding agents got good. They write code, run it, and fix it. But getting real, reliable software out of them is a skill. Andrej Karpathy calls it agentic engineering.

params.title: Learn *agentic engineering*
params.subtitle: Build real software with AI coding agents.

scenes.narration: Engineering, he says, because there's an art and a science to it. It's something you can learn, and get better at.

params.text: …“engineering” to emphasize that there is an art & science and expertise to it. It's something you can *learn and become better at*…
params.src: Vibe coding, one year later · X

scenes.narration: So this free course distills a hundred and twenty-six talks and articles, from the people who build these tools and use them every day, into twenty-four short animated lessons.

params.title: Distilled from the people building it

scenes.narration: You'll learn context engineering, the explore, plan, implement, verify loop, memory files, skills and hooks, subagents and parallel agents, evals, and how to stay safe from prompt injection.

items.text: Prompt injection and the lethal trifecta

scenes.narration: And here's the twist: your agent can take the course too. One command installs it as a skill, so your agent follows the same practices you learn.
Every lesson takes about four minutes, with a quiz, a hands-on exercise for your own agent, and a link to every source.
It's free, and open source. Start with lesson one today.
